---
title: "PairLoom next & recommendation"
author: "Yun Jiang"
---

## next

1. M: extend candidate discovery to slide gapped (indel-bearing) alignments via bounded local realignment.
2. M: batch the joint-rescue reference search with a multi-pattern index (Aho-Corasick style, per work chunk).
3. M: re-run the FULL benchmark with the deduplicated panel to confirm the pilot-level shifts at 6.1M-pair scale.
4. L: build a calibrated joint-MAPQ model for rescued pairs to replace the flat output MAPQ 0.
5. L: add a GitHub Actions workflow (pixi-based test matrix, ruff, benchmark smoke, `pixi run core` build) with Dependabot.
6. L: promote the synthetic known-fragment benchmark into the repo suite under `benchmarks/`.

## recommendation

1. M: use ZM to filter QC populations per family — e.g. `samtools view -e 'ZM=="chimeric_read"'` isolates concatemers.
2. M: choose between fastp and PairLoom by required semantics — sequence recovery vs placement honesty — not by merge rate.
3. M: deduplicate identical panel entries upstream or keep a duplicate-name map; 194 duplicate groups drove 578 MAPQ-0 refusals in the pilot.
4. M: for low-MAPQ-heavy cohorts on large references, measure joint-rescue cost on a sample first; `--no-rescue` opts out.
5. L: before relying on `--force-mapq60-exact`, quantify the repeat content of the target reference.
